library.name: AMK_CYD_Universal_TFT
library.author: Aung Moe Khine
library.sentence: Universal standalone TFT, touch, and sprite driver with LVGL support for all ESP32 Cheap Yellow Display (CYD) resistive boards.
library.paragraph: Bundles high-speed display and touch drivers with runtime hardware auto-probing for 2.4", 2.8", 3.2", 3.5", and 4.0" CYD resistive boards (ILI9341, ST7789, ST7796, XPT2046, including Dual-USB and ELEGOO 2.8" variants). Features full TFT_eSPI drop-in compatibility, TFT_eSprite off-screen buffering, persistent NVS touch calibration, and zero-boilerplate LVGL v8/v9 integration.
